scope: Native XLibre authentication and immutable connection identity
invariant: In strict mode, every native connection receives its immutable security identity before ordinary X requests run.
required_evidence: Both authorized hosts in Debug and ASan/UBSan
The native server is instrumented for focused core-X checks, with all identity assertions enabled and GLX disabled
Full P00-P10 baseline and unchanged locked assertions
Sealed protobuf bootstrap and strict authentication before host-access fallback
Immutable application labels and distinct native connection identities
Supervisor, broker, compositor, and application role separation
Revocation, issuer disconnect, descendant cancellation, and independent credential survival
Bounded credential storage, safe slot reuse, and new server generations
Ordinary Xlib authentication and both native byte orders
Malformed protobuf, unknown fields, invalid labels, replay, and unsupported version rejection
Independent mutations detect authentication bypass and missing disconnect revocation
limitations: This component does not enforce workspace resource isolation.
Strict mode is explicit; existing trusted diagnostic mode remains available.
Broker credential delivery and compositor security integration remain pending.
Retained resources require the forthcoming resource policy.
Instrumented GLX lifecycle checks expose installed graphics-driver leaks and remain failed pending a separate fix.
Native GPU and physical-device qualification remain pending.
